market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at $80,900-$82,500 on May 7, 2026; analyst sources cite May trading range $75-85k. May 4 print near $79,948 already shows $80k psychological zone is active. To dip to $75,000 needs another 7-8% drop. Plausible if 200dMA fails, but no print below $76k yet in May per available data. Market 0.505 close to fair, slight under estimate.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a deeper sell-off triggers stops near $75k or BTC bounces from $80k support.
